neighbours.label: the second ' the' in 'the <adjective> and the <adjective>' naming classes of people or qualities (the weak and the vulnerable, the mysterious and the supernatural)
fire: The charity feeds the hungry and the homeless every evening.
His poems dwell on the grotesque and the absurd.
The new tax falls hardest on the old and the infirm.
The festival honours the fallen and the forgotten.
She wrote about the sacred and the profane in village life.
The clinic was built for the blind and the deaf.
Philosophers have long argued over the beautiful and the sublime.
The plague struck down the mighty and the humble alike.
quiet: The charity feeds hungry families every evening.
His poems dwell on grotesque and absurd scenes.
The new tax falls hardest on old and infirm people.
The festival honours soldiers who were forgotten.
She wrote about a sacred well in the village.
The clinic was built for blind and deaf children.
He carried the bucket and the spade to the garden.
The plague struck down mighty kings and humble farmers alike.

notes: Card: peaks on ' the' in 'the lame and the elderly', 'the mysterious and the supernatural', and on 'ets' of 'Prophets' before names. Probes: 'the weak and the vulnerable' 0.49, 'the government and the opposition' 0.38, 'the sick and the elderly' 0.20, 'the rich and the poor' 0.18, 'the living and the dead' 0.13; concrete pairs (dogs/cats, door/window) 0.05-0.10. 'Prophets' + names also fires (0.32-0.65) and is outside this label, so the label is partial at best. Borderline on the median.
